name: winget-cli
description_en: WinGet is the Windows Package Manager. This project includes a CLI (Command Line Interface), PowerShell modules, and a COM (Component Object Model) API (Application Programming Interface).
readme_excerpt: Windows Package Manager WinGet Client If you are new to the Windows Package Manager, you might want to Explore the Windows Package Manager tool. The client has access to packages from two default sources. The first is "msstore" the Microsoft Store (free Apps rated "e" for everyone). The second is "winget" the WinGet community repository. > [!NOTE] > Group policy may be configured and modify configured sources. Run winget --info to see any configured policies.
